title_vi: Sự sụp đổ của Nhà Usher
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Béranger’s French epigraph is kept untranslated, as an epigraph.
Line breaks of the poem and the shield legend are preserved as separate lines; stanzas rhyme in alternating patterns with short refrain lines kept short.
decisions.rationale: Poe’s allegory of the mind’s decay depends on the poem being read as a poem.

decisions.decision: The sounds of the Mad Trist and their real echoes share fixed words (nghiến rít, tiếng thét, loảng xoảng, xé toạc).
decisions.rationale: The climax depends on the reader hearing the correspondences.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: House of Usher rendered Lâu đài (building only) in 1.2 and 1.17 but Nhà in 1.4 and 1.51, breaking the family/mansion double meaning; now Nhà Usher throughout.
The ‘hollow coffin’ no longer read as empty; ‘say, rather’ correction and the climax lines sharpened.
The final stanza and stanza II restored to rhyme; the shield legend made a rhymed couplet.
‘ideality’ as imaginative faculty (trí tưởng tượng) in 1.17 and 1.38; ‘you shall not’ as a prohibition; studio, opium-eater, turrets, forest and restrained hysteria corrected; several calques recast.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: Nhà Usher (the mansion itself: dinh thự)
glossary.rationale: Capitalised Nhà carries both the family and the building, as Poe’s unit 4 explains, so the final sentence keeps its double meaning.

glossary.source_term: tarn; fissure; sentience of vegetable things
glossary.draft_rendering: hồ đầm; vết nứt; tri giác của mọi loài thảo mộc
glossary.rationale: Fixed atmospheric terms that recur from the opening to the collapse.

glossary.draft_rendering: Cung điện ma ám; Cuộc hẹn hò điên loạn
glossary.rationale: The poem is rendered as rhymed Vietnamese verse with its stanza numerals and line breaks; the romance quotations use a pseudo-archaic register distinct from the narrator.

witness_decision: Selected the complete THE FALL OF THE HOUSE OF USHER section of The Works of Edgar Allan Poe, Raven Edition, vol. 2, as transcribed in Project Gutenberg #2148. First published in Burton’s Gentleman’s Magazine, September 1839; not collated.

unresolved_questions.explanation: The source’s comma before a parenthesis is copied as printed.

title_review.source_title: The Fall of the House of Usher
title_review.target_title: Sự sụp đổ của Nhà Usher
title_review.rationale: Sự sụp đổ của Nhà Usher: capitalised Nhà keeps both the dynasty and the building, matching the final sentence; Lâu đài would name only the building.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The poem rendered as rhymed verse with its allegory intact.
Final sentence keeps Poe’s chain of dashes and the double sense of the quoted “Nhà Usher”.
